title: Canadian Tofu Bake
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pungent flavors and a crispy tofu bake. This recipe is a great option for a satisfying and comforting meal.
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together flour, bake seasoning, and a pinch of salt.
Dip each tofu cube into the flour mixture, coating evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and cook until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the coated tofu cubes to the pan and cook until golden brown on all sides.
Transfer the tofu mixture to a baking dish and top with Canadian cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve hot.
